Your holdings: SOXL (-34.93%) and SPAL (-34.04%) are in deep drawdowns and flagged "SELL." These are leveraged ETFs that decay, and with margin, these drops hurt extra.

Watch: Keep an eye on the outcome of the Trump-Xi talks for any positive news on AI or trade. Also, closely monitor bond market movements and broader market sentiment for signs of a downturn.

Bottom line: Prioritize managing risk in your leveraged, underperforming positions given the market's current warnings.
plays: Consider trimming SOXL and SPAL given their deep drawdowns (-34% each) and leveraged decay, especially on margin. Respect their stops.
If looking to add to AI exposure, PLTR has an 'ACCUMULATE' signal at 190.85-190.49 with a stop at 189.75, aligning with AI talks.
